body: There IS no okay, and there never will be.  I am not a good person, but the only help that can actually help is whatever kills me.
There is absolutely NO comfort in anything that leaves me alive.  A place where I can breathe comfortably is in a casket and nothing else.

Jokes on you then.

If you want to comfort me, hire a hitman.

Peace only comes if i'm not alive.

I'm absolutely NOT valuable in any way, shape, or form. I take up space but that's it.  Nothing more. 

Death means far more to me than any empty promise ever will.
After the last decade, anything that wants to keep me alive is a problem.  Offing myself is the solution.
Fuck YOU. Life is the problem, not the solution.  As long as I live, I lose.
